name: evidence-lane-plugin
description: Private six-control Evidence Lane with secret-safe tracked intake, reconciled SQLite/Mermaid/DOT brains, explicit Chat Lineage, and exact-APPROVE Fuse.

interface.shortDescription: Run six governed controls over universal evidence brains.
interface.longDescription: Evidence Lane exposes Boot, Rollback, Build, Refresh, Mode, and Source Intake after root /evi. Boot atomically verifies locked ENV15/UOP15 Flash, prewarms optional native OCR dependencies before the MCP event loop, attaches secret-redacted visible lineage capture, and routes durable local versus configured remote storage fail-closed; Exit Boot detaches that runtime while preserving the installation and immutable evidence. Source Intake auto-detects all eighteen lanes and Project Engulf, uses tracked-only Git intake plus fail-closed secret and operational-path exclusions before SQLite/CAS/FTS, offers AUTO/REQUIRED/DISABLED Git history enrichment, and always includes Chat Lineage. Each lane's SQLite facts must reconcile with exact Mermaid and DOT node, edge, subgraph, and count claims. Mode accepts ordered known intersections and explicit custom schemas. The separate /evi-plugin administrative sidecar governs at most eight persistent connectors or AI toolchains with independent Codex/ChatGPT profiles, one-time purpose and role schemas, exact drop, and optional declared backend runtimes. Natural HIL intent is classified without promotion, while exact APPROVE alone invokes Fuse. State Travel remains conditional on an accepted sealed handoff and an explicit user request or genuine host-context exhaustion.
defaultPrompt: Run /evi, atomically Boot plus locked ENV/UOP Flash, and show the six controls.
Use /evi-source-intake with ordered sources and auto-detection or exact lane overrides.
Use /evi-refresh to seal an unaccepted candidate, show six-way HIL, and wait for my exact decision.
